preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of plans is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each mineral resource is labeled between 1 and n, inclusive.
The cities are numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
There are no self-loops in the roads.

preconditions.expression: The given roads form a tree
preconditions.description: The roads between cities form a tree structure.
The starting city of each plan is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The destination city of each plan is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The range of mineral resources is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: c_i = -1 if there is no mineral resource that meets the required condition
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if no mineral resource meets the conditions for the i-th plan.

postconditions.expression: c_i is the label of a mineral resource that appears an odd number of times between city u_i and city v_i and is within the range l_i to r_i
postconditions.description: The output is a mineral resource label that meets the conditions for the i-th plan.
